verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a collaboration client like Teams, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The export APIs and deleted-message retention are a different capability, and the community complaints are about notifications and bugs, not telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
